csv_project_name: Design For Swamp Rabbit Trail Wayfinding Master Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Greenville is seeking proposals for planning and design services for a Wayfinding Master Plan for the City of Greenville s portions of the Swamp Rabbit Trail Network, currently encompassing approximately 10 miles of pathways. The City is requesting proposals for turn-key planning and design services for the management, public input, design, and preparation of a full wayfinding package for the project. The consultant should provide a detailed approach to the project; however, the following framework is offered to provide guidance and understanding of the City s expectations. The proposal shall include all aspects of the project such as public and stakeholder input, inventory strategies, branding development, graphic design, regulatory and safety signage, installation detail design, lighting design, private property coordination and design, and the preparation of approved and permitted plans for implementation.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design, Graphic Design/Public Art
